Hi Erin —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can align on the technical deep dive: 

- Primary goal: validate throughput and latency for your chart-embedding use case (500k daily queries, P95 < 250ms).
- Data constraints: BrightLeaf will keep PHI in-house; inference will run in Dedicated mode or Private depending on legal review.
- Success criteria for the demo: run a short load test, confirm prefix/KV cache behavior on typical prompt shapes, and review cost/quantization tradeoffs.

Next steps I propose:
1) Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive with Markus (solutions engineer) to walk through the workload and run a short perf demo — can include a light load test.
2) Tessa will share procurement contact details and the template for a security questionnaire if needed.
3) I'll put together a calendar invite with a Zoom link and suggested attendee roster.

Can you let me know which of these slots works for your team?
- Tue June 1, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed June 2, 14:00–15:00 PT

Also, who from BrightLeaf should attend besides you? Is someone from engineering (e.g., infra lead) available to join?

Attaching a one-pager on Redwood inference and the notes I captured during the call.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.
